standards.name: Frictionless Data — Data Package / Table Schema / Table Dialect (Data Package v2)
standards.abstract: The Data Package standard describes how to package, describe and publish datasets, data files and tabular data (CSV/TSV/JSON and other file formats, and database tables). It is intended to describe collections of data resources (resources array, each resource pointing to file paths or inline data) plus structural metadata (table schemas, table dialects) so that tabular data and other resources can be discovered, validated and reused. The standard is developed and maintained by the Frictionless Data community (Open Knowledge Foundation involvement and a working group) and aims to improve FAIRness by providing an explicit JSON-based descriptor (datapackage.json) and related JSON-Schema profiles for resources, table dialects, and table schemas.

classification.rationale: The source material presents a concrete JSON descriptor model (datapackage.json) and explicit properties (package properties, resource properties, schema properties and dialect properties) with examples and JSON Schema–level rules. This is genuine field-level metadata (named properties with concrete types and example values), so this extraction is presented as a MetadataTable.

resource.schema.name: resource.schema
resource.schema.descr: Schema describing the resource data. For JSON resources this MUST follow JSON Schema; for tabular resources this references a Table Schema object.
resource.schema.type: object or string (JSON Schema or Table Schema reference)
resource.schema.evidence:
"A JSON Data Resource MUST be a [Data Resource][dr], that is it MUST conform to the [Data Resource specification][dr].

In addition:

- The Data Resource `schema` property MUST follow the [JSON Schema](https://json-schema.org/) specification, either as a JSON object directly under the property, or a string referencing another JSON document containing the JSON Schema"

resource.type.evidence: "`resource.type` (new) [`type`](/standard/data-resource/#type) allows to specify the resource type ([#51](https://github.com/frictionlessdata/datapackage-v2-draft/pull/51)). `resource.type: "table"` replaces `resource.profile: "tabular-data-resource"`."

"All compressed resources `MUST` have a `path` that allows the `compression` property to be inferred. If the compression can't be inferred from the `path` property (e.g. a custom file extension is used) then the `compression` property `MUST` be used to specify the compression.

Supported compression types:

- gz
- zip"

standards.name: ODAM datapackage (JSON Schema)
standards.abstract: This standard describes a data package format for packaging collections of dataset files together with structural metadata expressed as JSON Schema. It targets datasets (collections of data files and tables) and their structural metadata: column definitions, units of measurement and links to controlled vocabularies. The ODAM datapackage specification is maintained as part of the ODAM project (INRAE) and is closely aligned with the Frictionless Data (Data Package and Table Schema) specifications. The standard provides JSON Schema files (odam-data-package.json and odam-data-resource.json) and documents how components (table/schema descriptors, CSV descriptors, controlled vocabulary terms and categories) combine to form an ODAM data package (datapackage.json).

classification.rationale: The source presents a component composition diagram showing nodes (e.g. Data Resource, Table Schema, ODAM Table Schema, CSV Data Descriptor, ODAM Data Resource, Data Package, ODAM Data package, ODAM CV Term) and directed connections between them (H-->B, A-->E, etc.). This describes relationships and composition between structural components rather than a field-level metadata table or a prose checklist, so 'dag' best matches the source's actual structure.

standards.name: ODAM Data Package (ODAM JSON Schema profile)
standards.abstract: ODAM targets experimental data tables (tab-separated values) produced from designed experiments (DoE), e.g. the FRIM tomato fruit growth study, where objects of study are individuals/samples and measurements are recorded in simple TSV files. The standard is a JSON-Schema profile (maintained by the ODAM project / INRAE) that defines a datapackage descriptor and a tabular data resource descriptor, specifying structured metadata (package-level properties, resource paths, table schema, CSV dialect and controlled vocabulary links). It is intended to make experimental data bundles discoverable and machine-actionable (Frictionless Data–style datapackages) so datasets can be exposed via the ODAM web API and satisfy FAIR interoperability and reusability requirements.

classification.rationale: The source material is a JSON Schema that enumerates named properties and their concrete types (string, array, object, enum), i.e. field-level metadata definitions rather than prose instructions or ordered stages. It therefore represents a metadata table/schema rather than a principles checklist or DAG.
